notes: Timeline: the DateBar maker now outputs a grouped-objects 'Datebar' at the same position/height as Make Timeline, defaulting to the grey gradient with drop-shadowed labels; robust unit recognition reads the bar itself (two-bar aware) so Date Snap no longer fails on edited bars; Date Snap is split into Group Move and Line Nudge; Make Entry prompts for a date (Skip / Confirm / Confirm & Place, with auto-place on the timeline); entry text is now uniform across slides; smarter unit auto-detect uses the data's actual precision (full-date data stays Days across a year boundary) and Hours timelines position by clock time; the Copilot prompt keeps descriptions verbatim and returns a downloadable CSV/Excel file; the Timeline Edits menu is alphabetized. Calendar: a copied/duplicated calendar slide is still recognized by the Entry Manager, and Day Suffix Toggle works on the object datebar.
